description: This file defines internal instrument wrappers for OpenTelemetry metrics, including observable counters, up-down counters, gauges, and their synchronous counterparts, with support for setting delegates and unwrapping underlying implementations.

classes.name: unwrapper
classes.description: Interface for unwrapping to get the underlying metric.Observable implementation.

classes.name: afCounter
classes.description: Wrapper for Float64ObservableCounter with delegate management.

classes.name: afUpDownCounter
classes.description: Wrapper for Float64ObservableUpDownCounter with delegate management.

classes.name: afGauge
classes.description: Wrapper for Float64ObservableGauge with delegate management.

classes.name: aiCounter
classes.description: Wrapper for Int64ObservableCounter with delegate management.

classes.name: aiUpDownCounter
classes.description: Wrapper for Int64ObservableUpDownCounter with delegate management.

classes.name: aiGauge
classes.description: Wrapper for Int64ObservableGauge with delegate management.

methods.name: setDelegate
methods.description: Sets the delegate metric instrument using the provided Meter.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a value to the counter or up-down counter.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a measurement for histogram or gauge.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the instrument is enabled in the current context.
